quiz_title: Web Design - Quiz 3: Containers & CSS Selectors

questions.q: What is the difference between a <div> and a <span>?
opts: Div is inline, span is block
Div is block-level, span is inline
Div is only for images, span for text
questions.exp: Div starts on a new line (block), whereas span stays inline on the same line to style words.

questions.q: How do you select a class named 'header' in CSS?
questions.exp: In CSS, class selectors start with a dot (.), e.g. .header, while ID selectors start with a hash (#).

questions.q: Where in an HTML document is the best place to link an external CSS stylesheet?
questions.exp: Linking stylesheet links in the <head> block ensures the styles load before the page renders, preventing lags!

questions.q: What does the 'A' in RGBA color stand for?
questions.exp: The Alpha channel in RGBA controls the transparency/opacity of the color, ranging from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid).

questions.q: How do you write a hex code for a pure white background color?
questions.exp: #ffffff represents pure white, while #000000 represents pure black.
